look: Geode Treant, a B-rank GKOM variant from the Shardlings family: ancient oak treant split open to show a cavern of crystal inside its trunk. Family anatomy: living saplings and trees of bark and roots with crystal buds and geode hollows. Build: large, heavy and imposing. GKOM rank cue: half the body armoured in GKOM crystal, natural patches between the plates; the crystals are pale green quartz. A softball-sized GKOM core orb, dark crimson with a steady pulse, is embedded visibly in its chest or body centre. Element Earth: amber, moss green and slate accents, strong stone shards, crystal dust and drifting petals
